summary: Li Auto filed a 6-K (US equivalent of an HKEX discloseable-transaction announcement) disclosing an RMB1.625 billion equity financing by subsidiary Shanghai Mahe Xin Technology, its chip and domain-controller platform. Li Auto invests RMB1.0 billion and external investors (Hangzhou Jingtao, Lanchi Ventures, Huaye Tiancheng, MiraclePlus) RMB625 million, plus a one-off Hangzhou Jingtao right of up to RMB500 million exercisable by December 31, 2026, at the same per-unit price. Assuming full incentive-plan adoption and right exercise, Li Auto would hold about 74.01%, investors 6.58%, incentive vehicles 19.41%, retaining consolidation. This is a routine subsidiary capital raise, not a special situation; watch closing conditions and dilution mechanics.
